title: docs: the example CRM size stated on three pages (1,792 lines across 31 files) has drifted — the pages' own count command prints 1,929 lines on main
body:
立卡门 class a — a measurement the docs state is wrong on main; reach measured, not inferred.

## What is wrong

Three pages state the bundled example CRM (examples/app-crm) as **1,792 lines across 31 files, about 16,000 tokens, about 8% of a 200k-token context window**:

- content/docs/concepts/metadata-driven.mdx, section "4. Small Enough to Fit in an Agent's Context" (the table at line 232)
- content/docs/getting-started/how-ai-development-works.mdx, line 37
- content/blog/context-window-is-the-constraint.mdx, the table at line 42

The metadata-driven page prints its own command and invites the reader to count:

```bash
find examples/app-crm/src -name '*.ts' -not -name '*.test.ts' | xargs cat | wc -l
```

Run against origin/main at 31cd2104 on 2026-10-08 it answers **31 files, 1,929 lines**. The reader who follows "Count it yourself" gets a figure 137 lines above the one on the page. The figure first appears in the tree on 2026-10-02 (commit 100c394f), so the drift is six days old and will keep growing with every change to the example.

## Reach

- Measured on main by the seat, with the page's own command, as above. Also measured independently by the developer on #22240 at base 3ae59661 (same 1,929), who applied that card's rule that the only number a page may carry is this one, found it stale, and had the new page link to the measurement section instead of repeating the number.
- Three reader-facing pages, one of them a blog post; the token and percentage figures beside the line count are derived from it and are stale by the same proportion.

## What done looks like

- The three pages carry the figure measured at the fixing PR's base, counted with the command the page prints, and the token and percentage estimates re-derived the way the page describes them (approximate, same method).
- Nothing else on the pages changes. No gate is added: the maintainer has not named one, and the default is not to add.
- Docs-only. The blog post is included because it carries the same table; whether that post gets a fuller rewrite is a separate maintainer decision and not this card.

## Who acts

domain:devx lane (inherited from the in-flight parent #22240, where the finding was reported). Awaiting first grading as a finding; one card covers all three locations.

## Duplicate check (2026-10-08, open and closed)

- Query "example CRM line count 1,792 lines 31 files drifted docs metadata-driven measurement stale": 51 hits by semantic match; the ten best are #22190, #22238, #22212, #21863, #20234, #20233, #17723, #15418, #17288 and #22072, none about this figure.
- Query "context window measurement app-crm size tokens docs count it yourself drift": 0 hits.
